g.text: Can anything cut insertion sort’s one-step shuffles?
A shift copies one card one gap to the right. Gap 1 is ordinary insertion sort.
Can anything cut insertion sort’s one-step shuffles?
A shift copies one card one gap to the right. Gap 1 is ordinary insertion sort.
every card one step from home; arcs = last pass shifts (4 of 8 drawn)
Hint: run plain insertion, then the four Shell passes.
Can anything cut insertion sort’s one-step shuffles?
A shift copies one card one gap to the right. Gap 1 is ordinary insertion sort.
Plain insertion made 120 shifts: the 1 walked 15
places, one at a time. Shell made 8 per pass, 32 in
all. Farthest from its place: 15, then 7, 3, 1. At
gap 1 every card was a step from home.
